title: Astro Portal session event payload: sensor_temperature_drift
description: A drift of the camera sensor's temperature during the session, found by Astro Sync in the frames: from `fromCelsius` to `toCelsius` (degrees Celsius). The instant is the event's own `recordedAt`, the first frame past the threshold. See session-events.md.

description.description: Optional sentence for an application that does not know this type: it shows it as an ordinary report. The applications that know the type compose their own sentence, in the person's language, from the structured fields.
